2607.08541.title: VocaDet: Sample-Driven Open-Vocabulary Object Detection and Segmentation via Visual Tokenization and Vector Database Retrieval
2607.08541.paper_summary: Open-vocabulary object detection and segmentation aim to recognize arbitrary objects beyond predefined categories. Although recent vision-language and reference-based approaches have significantly advanced this field, they often rely on text prompts, limited visual examples, or expensive feature matching procedures, making them difficult to scale to large and continuously expanding object repositories. In this work, we propose VocaDet, a sample-driven open-vocabulary object detection and segmentation framework that learns object concepts directly from user-provided positive and negative sample collections without model retraining. The key idea is to transform continuous visual representations into discrete visual vocabularies and perform efficient retrieval-based recognition through a scalable vector database. Specifically, we employ DINOv3 as the visual feature extractor and apply agglomerative clustering with adaptive clustering sensitivity to generate multi-granularity visual tokens. These visual tokens, together with position-debiased representations and spatial topology information, are stored as expandable object memories in a vector database. During inference, query images are converted into visual tokens and efficiently matched against the stored object memories for object localization and segmentation. Furthermore, a background filtering mechanism is introduced to remove frequently occurring background patterns and reduce redundant retrieval operations in practical fixed-camera scenarios. Experiments on the UA-DETRAC dataset demonstrate that VocaDet achieves effective open-vocabulary detection performance without conventional detector training, while supporting continuously expandable recognition capability as additional positive and negative samples are accumulated.
2607.08541.paper_summary_zh: 開放詞彙的物體檢測和分割旨在識別超出預定類別的任意物體。儘管最近的視覺-語言和基於參考的方法在這一領域取得了顯著進展，但它們通常依賴於文本提示、有限的視覺範例或昂貴的特徵匹配程序，這使得它們難以擴展到大型且不斷擴展的物體庫。在這項工作中，我們提出了VocaDet，一個基於樣本驅動的開放詞彙物體檢測和分割框架，該框架直接從用戶提供的正負樣本集合中學習物體概念，而無需模型重訓。其關鍵思想是將連續的視覺表示轉換為離散的視覺詞彙，並通過可擴展的向量數據庫進行高效的檢索式識別。具體而言，我們使用DINOv3作為視覺特徵提取器，並應用具有自適應聚類靈敏度的聚合聚類來生成多粒度的視覺標記。這些視覺標記與位置去偏見表示和空間拓撲信息一起，作為可擴展的物體記憶存儲在向量數據庫中。在推理過程中，查詢圖像被轉換為視覺標記，並高效地與存儲的物體記憶進行匹配，以實現物體定位和分割。此外，還引入了一種背景過濾機制，以去除經常出現的背景模式，並減少在實際固定攝像頭場景中的冗餘檢索操作。在UA-DETRAC數據集上的實驗表明，VocaDet在不進行傳統檢測器訓練的情況下，實現了有效的開放詞彙檢測性能，同時支持隨著額外正負樣本的積累而不斷擴展的識別能力。
